title: Jack & Jones
summary: Delivered the complete fit-out for Jack & Jones, transforming the store into a modern, stylish retail space that reflects the brand’s identity. The project included interior finishes, custom fixtures, lighting, and layout planning to create an engaging and functional shopping environment. Every detail was carefully executed to ensure a seamless blend of aesthetics and operational efficiency, providing customers with a premium in-store experience.

approval.note: Client confirmed MENAARC holds the rights to present this project. Source archive: righteousgrp.com.
